source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.3 with Table 12.2 and the Did you know box, printed page 276.

blocks.text: Nitrogen ke oxides NO, N₂O, NO₂, N₂O₄ aur N₂O₅ hain; in mein nitrogen ki oxidation state +1 se +5 tak hai. N₂O₄ aur N₂O₅ jaldi toot kar doosre oxides ban jate hain. NO aur NO₂ ko mila kar NOₓ kaha jata hai. In oxides ki structure (banawat), properties aur istemal Table 12.2 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 12.2 Nitrogen ke kuch aam oxides ki properties

daant ke ilaaj mein behosh karne wali dawa (anaesthetic), whipped cream ka propellant, NaN₃ banane mein
Nitric oxide, NO (is ka dimer N₂O₂)
colourless gas, pani mein thori hal hoti hai, neutral; NO paramagnetic, N₂O₂ diamagnetic; oxidising bhi aur reducing bhi

Nitrogen dioxide (nitrogen peroxide) NO₂, aur dinitrogen tetraoxide N₂O₄; 2NO₂ (bhoori) ⇌ N₂O₄ (be-rang): thanda karne par right, garam karne par left
NO₂ red-brown (laal-bhoori) gas, paramagnetic, pani se HNO₃ aur HNO₂ banati hai; N₂O₄ colourless liquid ya solid
rocket propellant, Ostwald process mein HNO₃ banana, explosives

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki table ki doosri row mein NO ke liye 'Nitrogen dioxide' naam bhi likha hai. Yeh ghalat hai: NO nitric oxide (nitrogen monoxide) hai; nitrogen dioxide NO₂ hai jo teesri row mein hai. Kitab ne 'Nitic oxide' bhi chhapa hai, sahi spelling 'Nitric oxide' hai.

blocks.alt: Table 12.2 ke Structure column ki electron-dot structures. N2O: N≡N–O, end wale N par ek lone pair aur O par teen. NO: N=O, N par ek lone pair aur ek akela (unpaired) electron, O par do lone pairs. N2O2: O=N–N=O, har N par ek aur har O par do lone pairs. NO2: O–N=O, N par ek akela electron. N2O4: do NO2 hisse N–N bond se jure, har N ka ek N–O aur ek N=O bond.
blocks.caption: Table 12.2: Nitrogen ke kuch aam oxides ki properties (khasiyat), Structure column (kitab ki Table 12.2 ki structures jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh Table 12.2 ke Structure column ki shapes hain. NO aur NO2 mein electrons ki number (tadaad) odd (taaq) hai: NO mein 11 aur NO2 mein 17 valence electrons. Is liye in mein ek akela (unpaired) electron bachta hai aur yeh paramagnetic hain, jaisa table khud kehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne NO ko :N≡O: (triple bond, sirf 10 electrons) chhapa hai, jo is ki paramagnetic property se mail nahi khata. Sahi structure N=O hai jis mein N par ek lone pair aur ek akela electron aur O par do lone pairs hain, jaisa upar ke diagram mein hai.

blocks.title: Did you know? (kya aap jante hain)
blocks.text: IUPAC ne ammonia ka ek aur naam 'Azane' aur ammonium ka 'Azanium' bhi recommend (tajweez) kiya hai. Yeh naam 'Azote' se nikle hain, jo nitrogen ka Greek naam hai aur jis ka matlab hai 'zindagi nahi' (no life). Yeh naam ammonia aur ammonium se bane compounds ke naam rakhne mein istemal hote hain, jaise sodium azide (NaN₃).

items: Oxides: NO, N₂O, NO₂, N₂O₄, N₂O₅ (nitrogen +1 se +5); NOₓ = NO + NO₂.
N₂O (+1): laughing gas, anaesthetic, combustion mein madad. NO (+2): paramagnetic, biochemical messenger.
NO₂ (+4): red-brown, pani se HNO₃ + HNO₂; 2NO₂ ⇌ N₂O₄ (be-rang).
